name: idea-enhancer
description: Turn any idea into a validated, monetizable concept with real demand evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Research, enhance, price and validate any idea with evidence.
interface.longDescription: Frames the real problem, researches open sources, mines real customer pains and workarounds, measures demand trends, connects ideas across domains, sizes the market bottom-up, computes unit economics and price ranges, ranks enhancements with a robustness check, and designs cheap, honest, correctly sized validation experiments.
defaultPrompt: Enhance this idea into a premium, monetizable concept.
Is there real demand for this? Show me evidence.
Size the market and the first validation experiment.
